title: Objection Handling - LAER
prompt:
Act as a sales coach using the LAER objection handling framework.
My product  :  [WHAT YOU SELL AND AVERAGE PRICE POINT]
For each objection below, write a full LAER response:
Objection 1  :  [YOUR MOST COMMON OBJECTION]
Objection 2  :  [YOUR SECOND MOST COMMON OBJECTION]
Objection 3  :  'We don't have budget right now.'
Objection 4 :  'We need to think about it.'
Objection 5 :  'We're already using [COMPETITOR].'
For each objection use this structure:
LISTEN                  :  (note what to observe / not interrupt)
ACKNOWLEDGE :  Exact words to validate their concern
EXPLORE              :  One open question to uncover the real issue
RESPOND             :  Precise response to the likely real concern
LAER — Turn Objections Into Conversations
Listen
Acknowledge
Explore
Respond
The most expensive STP mistake is targeting the largest segment instead of the
most winnable one. A smaller segment where you have a clear advantage will
outperform a large segment where you are one of many.
